summary.statement: Checked formal and executable properties apply only to their recorded premises and domains. Legal source meaning, completeness and unknown future legal situations remain qualified.

fact_classifications.meaning: The assessed fund is either a UCITS domiciled in France, Luxembourg, Ireland or the Netherlands, or a United Kingdom-domiciled collective investment scheme authorised as UK UCITS.
fact_classifications.name: covered_ucits

fact_classifications.meaning: The identified change is a post-authorisation matter for an already SFC-authorised fund.
fact_classifications.name: post_authorisation_change

fact_classifications.meaning: The identified change materially alters at least one investment objective, policy or restriction of the fund.
fact_classifications.name: material_investment_change

fact_classifications.meaning: Date for which the substantive removal conditions are assessed.
fact_classifications.name: assessment_date

fact_classifications.meaning: The identified change satisfies every home-jurisdiction requirement applicable to that change.
fact_classifications.name: home_requirements_met
fact_classifications.unit: truth value across applicable home requirements

fact_classifications.meaning: At least one product feature involved in the identified change is novel.
fact_classifications.name: involves_novel_feature
fact_classifications.unit: truth value across involved product features

fact_classifications.meaning: At least one product feature involved in the identified change is complex.
fact_classifications.name: involves_complex_feature
fact_classifications.unit: truth value across involved product features

fact_classifications.meaning: The identified change may have local policy implications, whether or not those implications have actually occurred.
fact_classifications.name: possible_local_policy_implications
fact_classifications.unit: truth value for possible implications of the change

reading_assumptions: The assessment concerns one identified material post-authorisation investment change to an SFC-authorised fund within the circular’s UCITS definition.
All product features involved in the identified change are assessed; the source supplies no rule for severing a bundled change.
28 November 2025 governs commencement of the removal measure.
The transition preserves the process for an existing application; it does not expressly make application history an additional substantive exception to the removal measure.
Substantive qualification for removal does not establish permission to bypass a preserved application process or establish overall legal compliance.
reading_questions: What are the fund’s domicile, UCITS classification and, where relevant, UK UCITS authorisation status?
Which objectives, policies, restrictions and product features are involved in the identified material change?
Does the change meet every applicable home-jurisdiction requirement, involve any novel or complex feature, or possibly have local policy implications?
Which application covers which change components, when did the SFC receive it, and what decisions had been granted at the Effective Date and by the assessment date?
Do the referenced FAQs make preservation of an application’s existing process a bar to substantive removal, and how do they treat subsequent decisions, amendments, withdrawal or resubmission?
What existing rules determine whether prior approval is required when the substantive removal conditions are not met?
